study type: Pilot intervention study with a pre-post design and a no-intervention baseline
cohort: Eighteen children, aged 7-12 years, with poor reading and/or spelling, receiving literacy interventions via videoconferencing in their homes and/or schools.
finding: Children's scores on 2 of 3 reading and spelling outcome measures significantly improved more during the videoconferencing intervention period compared to a no-intervention baseline period.
